name: Stop the Screeching
label: Quest
description: Stop the Screeching: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Screeching Canyon is home to a local band of harpies known for their ferocious nature and raiding tactics. They have ambushed the last few supply caravans that have been brave enough to traverse this place.
I fear if something isn't done soon, there will be no caravans that will dare make the trek to Freewind Post.
Go, slay as many of these harpies as you are able. Return to me once the deed has been done, and I will reward you well for your efforts.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is wonderful news! I will send word to our suppliers that the harpies have been dealt with. At least that is one less threat the future caravans will need to worry about.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
